subject.title: fix(cli): oversized secrets plans consume unbounded memory

question: Should saved secrets plans use 16 MiB as the permanent documented compatibility ceiling for both generation and application?
rationale: The implementation safely enforces a shared limit, but selecting the public ceiling affects existing external generators and unusually large operator-authored plans and therefore requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept 16 MiB
options.body: Keep the proposed shared ceiling, documentation, diagnostics, and exact-boundary regression coverage.

options.title: Revise the ceiling
options.body: Select a different documented byte limit while preserving the symmetric configure/apply contract and tests.

recommendation.title: Accept 16 MiB
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed shared ceiling, documentation, diagnostics, and exact-boundary regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects steipete to the canonical secrets documentation and repository policy surface, making this the best available individual routing candidate alongside the security-owner team.
